articles.title: US Stock Market: Fed’s inflation fight puts Kevin Warsh’s credibility to the test
articles.content: The US Federal Reserve faces a tough policy decision as Chair Kevin Warsh weighs a potential rate hike to strengthen its inflation-fighting stance against the need to support an uncertain economy. While higher rates could help bring inflation back toward the 2% target, mixed labour market signals and energy price risks from the US-Iran conflict are pushing the Fed to remain cautious.

articles.title: RR Kabel shares jump 10% as Q1 PAT surges 129% YoY, Ebitda doubles
articles.content: RR Kabel reported a strong June-quarter performance, with profit after tax surging 129% year-on-year and Ebitda nearly doubling, driven by robust growth in its Wires & Cables business and improving profitability. The company also achieved operational breakeven in its FMEG segment, while management expressed confidence in sustaining growth through product expansion, distribution strengthening and execution excellence.

articles.title: Global Market: China stocks slide to one-week low as AI valuation concerns hit tech shares
articles.content: Chinese stocks fell to a one-week low on Tuesday, led by a sharp selloff in technology and semiconductor shares as investors questioned AI-driven valuations. The CSI300 dropped 2.3% alongside declines in key tech indices, mirroring broader market anxiety across Asian markets over rising competition and heavy AI spending.

articles.title: HUL Q1 Results: Revenue rises 10% YoY to Rs 17,149 crore, but profit falls 3% on one-off tax credit
articles.content: HUL Q1 Results: Hindustan Unilever (HUL) reported a 3% year-on-year decline in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 2,673 crore, missing analysts' estimates, as the year-ago quarter included a one-off tax credit. Revenue, however, rose 10.2% to Rs 17,149 crore, driven by 10% underlying sales growth. HUL shares fell over 3% following the earnings announcement.

articles.title: Happiest Minds Q1 Results: Profit rises 18% YoY to Rs 68 crore; revenue up 14%
articles.content: Happiest Minds Technologies announced an 18.3 percent net profit increase for the first quarter.  Revenue from operations also saw a 14.3 percent rise during the same period. articles.title: Global Market: ECB may need more rate hikes to curb inflation risks, says Kazimir
articles.content: Slovak central bank governor Peter Kazimir warned that the European Central Bank may need to raise interest rates at least once more to control inflation. articles.title: Rupee rises 35 paise to 95.64 against US dollar in early trade
articles.content: The Indian rupee strengthened significantly against the US dollar in early trade. Lower crude oil prices and easing geopolitical tensions boosted the rupee's momentum. A weaker US dollar index and positive equity market sentiment also supported the currency. Foreign institutional investors offloaded equities worth Rs 1,688.23 crore on Monday. The Sensex and Nifty saw marginal gains in early trading sessions.

articles.title: Xtranet Technologies IPO allotment likely today; GMP signals modest listing gains. Here's how to check status
articles.content: Xtranet Technologies is set to finalise its IPO allotment today, with the stock scheduled to list on July 30. articles.title: Sensex trades flat, Nifty near 24,000 ahead of US Fed meet; IT pack shines
articles.content: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded largely flat on Tuesday. IT stocks advanced, led by Infosys, while broader markets showed mixed performance. Foreign institutional investors sold equities while domestic investors bought shares.

articles.title: Bharat Electronics shares fall over 3% after Q1 results. Here's what Nomura, Motilal Oswal and other brokerages say
articles.content: Bharat Electronics (BEL) shares fell 3.5% after the defence PSU reported mixed Q1FY27 results, with profit rising 9% year-on-year but declining sharply on a sequential basis. articles.title: Coal India shares fall 2% after Q1 results. What are Jefferies, other brokerages saying?
articles.content: Coal India shares fell after the state-run miner reported a marginal 1% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 8,852 crore, while profit declined over 18% sequentially. articles.title: Global Market: Samsung, SK Hynix plunge up to 11% as investors reassess AI chip boom
articles.content: South Korean chip stocks experienced sharp declines on Tuesday. Major companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix saw significant drops. Investors scaled back artificial intelligence-related bets due to spending sustainability worries. Concerns over China's semiconductor advancements also fueled market unease. This selloff reflects a broader reassessment of AI valuations and future demand.

articles.title: India's crorepati list is growing but the problem is who will manage their money
articles.content: India's ultra-rich population is rapidly increasing, creating a significant advisory gap.  The number of wealthy individuals has grown substantially, demanding more skilled wealth managers.  This shortage is driving up costs and competition for experienced financial advisors.  Firms are investing in technology and talent to manage this expanding client base.  The wealth management sector faces challenges in matching growth with quality of advice.
